messages.author: a76d30a86cea8252
messages.subject: Re: Will Shiny Server be able to access MS SQL databases?
parts:
Try this: 
ocbcDriverConnect(connection = "Driver=SQL Server; Server=TESTSERVER;Integrated Security=SSPI;Database=TESTDB")

The "Integrated Security=SSPI" bit with it set to SSPI means that you will be using Windows Authentication, so you shouldn't have to enter your userid/password. Check this stackoverflow post about integrated security: http://stackoverflow.com/questions/1229691/difference-between-integrated-security-true-and-integrated-security-sspi
